findings.title: Planning-artifact detection counts matching directories as files
findings.description: `readdir` returns both files and directories, but the matching entries are accepted based only on their names. A directory named, for example, `100-arch.project.md` therefore makes the project appear already planned, skipping brownfield detection even though no planning artifact file exists. Check entry types before treating a match as an artifact.

findings.title: Source-walk entry cap is applied after reading and sorting each directory
findings.description: `listDirectory` reads and sorts the entire directory before `walk` increments `tally.entries` and enforces `MAX_WALK_ENTRIES`. A single very large directory can therefore consume substantial time and memory before the cap takes effect, undermining the walk’s stated resource bound. Apply a bound while enumerating, or otherwise ensure a directory cannot be fully materialized beyond the intended limit.
